rows.quote: For the brain imaging and AD genetic datasets, we used the brain imaging GWAS from UKB (453 T1 MRI and DTI imaging; Smith et al. 2021), and AD GWAS from Bellenguez et al. 2022.
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the AD GWAS to Bellenguez et al. 2022; that author-year citation belongs to one dictionary row only.
UKB-PPP named with a protein count and assay only; no cohort subset, exact N or citation.

rows.quote: Method We leverage the protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) datasets from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB‐PPP; 2,625 proteins by Olink assay) and deCODE genetics (Ferkingstad et al. 2021; 4,472 proteins by SomaLogic assay).
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the deCODE genetics pQTL dataset to Ferkingstad et al. 2021 with a SomaLogic assay; that author-year citation belongs to one pqtl dictionary row only.
